_comment: Documents the intended branch protection settings. Apply via GitHub Settings -> Branches or the GitHub API (PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/{branch}/protection). This is a record of intent, not an applied setting: branch protection cannot be set from a pull request, so a maintainer must enable it.
_note: The branch is test-implement-drips, the repository's current default. If the default branch is ever renamed, update this and the workflow triggers together.
